errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states that the chart illustrates 'staatlichen Ausgaben als Prozentsatz des Bruttoinlandsprodukts (BIP) verschiedener europäischer Länder.' The machine-generated description does not clearly state the purpose of the chart beyond showing expenditures and increases.

The reference description states that Poland's bar reaches 'bis etwa 3,5 %,' while the machine-generated description claims it reaches 'etwa 4,1 %.' The image shows the total for Poland closer to 3.5-3.6%, not 4.1%.
The machine-generated description claims the shortest bars (Luxembourg and Spain) are 'etwa 1,2–1,3 %.' The image shows these bars closer to approximately 1.0-1.1%.

The reference description mentions that the black line indicates '1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021,' but the machine-generated description does not clarify that this line is a threshold or reference value, only describing it as a 'Marker.'

The reference description specifies that the x-axis has a 'lineare Skala von 0 bis 4 mit Intervallen von 0,5.' The machine-generated description omits the 0.5 interval detail, only mentioning tick marks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4.

The reference description highlights that 'Polen, Estland und Lettland zeigen die höchsten grünen Balken, die bis etwa 3,5 % reichen,' and that 'Italien, Belgien, Slowenien, Luxemburg und Spanien haben vergleichsweise kürzere grüne Balken, die alle unter 2 % des BIP verbleiben.' The machine-generated description does not explicitly mention these key observations.
